summary.result: Through this study the nitrogen isotope mass ratio has been found to be useful for estimating nitrate sources and their contribution to the rural watersheds.
summary.background: Pollution sources and their environmental contributions were investigated to select the best management practices for the effective control of water quality.
summary.method: They were sequentially prepared through distillation method and analyzed using an isotope ratio mass spectrometer(IsoPrime EA).
